configurations._comment: Serves the built bundle from dist/. Use this rather than wilson-dev when measuring network behaviour: `vite` dev serves every module unbundled, which fills the browser's 250-entry resource-timing buffer before the app has finished booting and makes any later request invisible. Run `npm run build` first.
configurations.name: wilson-preview-build

configurations._comment: V1: the SIGN-IN screens, without editing .env.local. Vite ranks a variable already in the process environment above .env files, so this sets VITE_DEV_AUTOLOGIN to a value the app ignores (App.jsx signs in only on the exact string tester) and the auth screens render while .env.local still says tester. Port 5246; the signed-in server stays on 5245.
configurations.name: v1-auth

configurations._comment: A session's own dev server (docs/sessions/PLAN_TO_1_0.md section 5, rule 2: three fixed entries, session-a/b/c on 5301-5303, and no entry per session). dg2-worktree's recipe: the dev fixtures' tester, no .env.local needed (the four VITE_ variables are set in the process environment), the Supabase pair a placeholder on a closed local port, so nothing real is reached and no AI call can be made. It serves WILSON/ of the worktree this file is in (the path is relative to the worktree root). Port 5301, strict: a busy port fails rather than moving.
configurations.name: session-a
runtimeArgs: set VITE_DEV_FIXTURES=1&& set VITE_DEV_AUTOLOGIN=tester&& set VITE_SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9&& set VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=fixtures-only&& npx vite WILSON --port 5301 --strictPort
